primary.title: Vodafone Idea News: Clarification from telecom giant on ₹53 crore income tax refund order
primary.summary: Vodafone Idea clarified that a Delhi High Court directive regarding a ₹53.09 crore tax refund is a routine matter and does not require formal disclosure under SEBI regulations. The stock surged 8% following the news, as the company prepares to secure significant funding.
